info.title: Benefits Platform Claims API
info.description:
The 'Claims' web service is a component of the Benefits Platform designed to retrieve detailed
						information about submitted claims, and associated information such as receipts and payees.
						The Benefits Platform encompasses various benefits management systems such as HSA, FSA, HRA
						management, and COBRA coverage.

get.description: Retrieve detailed information about a claim and related information by Person ID and Claim Number

parameters.name: person_id
parameters.description: The GUID generated by the Identity Management System for accessing information belonging to this specific person.

parameters.name: claim_number
parameters.description: The Claim number, an alphanumeric string, e.g. 11BPEB1210513P0000101

parameters.name: X-Request-Id
parameters.description: Optional correlation ID associated with the request, comprised of alphanumeric or hyphen characters up to 36 characters in length.

404.description: Not Found.  No Consumer found for supplied ID.

get.description: This endpoint is used to check the liveness of the service. This is just a simple ping to see if the service is alive.

claim_number.description: A unique identifier assigned to the claim.

claim_amount.description: The total amount of the claim submitted.

claim_status.description: The current processing status of the claim.

submission_date.description: The date the claim was submitted.

start_date_of_service.description: The first date services were provided for the claim.

end_date_of_service.description: The last date services were provided for the claim.

processed_date.description: The date the claim was processed.

provider_name.description: The name of the provider associated with the claim.

paid_amount.description: The amount reimbursed for the claim.

submitted_amount.description: The original amount submitted for reimbursement.

is_ptp.description: Indicates whether the claim is part of a pay-the-provider process.

denial_reasons.description: The reason(s) the submitted claim was denied, if applicable.

requests_for_more_information.description: Request(s) for additional information for the submitted claim, if applicable.

receipt_status.description: The status of receipt submission for the claim.

denied_amount.description: The total amount of the claim that was denied.

applied_copay_amount.description: The portion of the claim amount applied to a copay.

applied_coinsurance_amount.description: The portion of the claim amount applied to coinsurance.

applied_deductible_amount.description: The portion of the claim amount applied to a deductible.

claim_source.description: The source of the claim submission.

scheduled_for_reimbursement_date.description: The date the claim is scheduled for reimbursement.

ClaimDTO.description: Claim Object containing details of a claim, including the claim number, amount, and status, submission date, start and end date of service, paid and submitted amount.

index.description: Current page index (i.e. page number minus one)

has_next.description: Indicated whether there are additional pages

ClaimsDTO.description: Claims Object containing a list of claims and pagination information

denial_code.description: The code identifying the reason for denial.

reason.description: A brief description of why the claim was denied.

denial_date_time.description: The date and time the claim was denied.

is_upload_receipt_allowed.description: Indicates whether a receipt can be uploaded to resolve the denial.

explanation.description: A detailed explanation of the denial reason.

action_required.description: The action needed to resolve the denial.

DenialReasonDTO.description: Denial Reason Object contain details on why a claim was denied

payee_tin.description: The Tax Identification Number (TIN) associated with the payee.

payee_id.description: A unique identifier for the payee.

name.description: The full name of the payee.

account_number.description: The account number associated with the payee.

address_line1.description: The first line of the payee's address.

address_line2.description: The second line of the payee's address, if applicable.

address_line3.description: The third line of the payee's address, if applicable.

address_line4.description: The fourth line of the payee's address, if applicable.

PayeeDTO.description: Payee object containing details of the payee.

index.description: Current page index (i.e. page number minus one)

has_next.description: Indicated whether there are additional pages

PayeesDTO.description: Payees object containing a list of payee objects and pagination information

receipt_id.description: The unique identifier assigned to the receipt.

file_name.description: The name of the uploaded receipt file.

file_size.description: The size of the receipt file in bytes.

content_type.description: The type of content in the receipt.

upload_date.description: The date the receipt was uploaded.

tracked_expense_number.description: The number associated with the tracked expense related to the receipt.

claim_numbers.description: A list of claim numbers linked to the receipt.

ReceiptDTO.description: Receipt Object that contains information about a receipt, including the file name, size, content type, upload date, and associated claim numbers.

index.description: Current page index (i.e. page number minus one)

has_next.description: Indicated whether there are additional pages

ReceiptsDTO.description: Receipts Object containing a list of receipts and pagination information

action_date.description: The date action was requested to provide more information

reason.description: A brief description of the reason for the request.

code.description: The code associated with the request for more information.

description.description: A detailed description of the information requested.

status.description: The status of the request for more information.

note.description: Additional notes or comments regarding the request.

RmiDTO.description: Request for More Information object containing details on why a claim needs more information
